# Security Review — pass1

## Summary
The entity rename redirects feature (`backstage.io/former-names`) is well-hardened against unauthorized information disclosure, entity name hijacking, and open redirects across all touched backend, client, frontend, test, and documentation files. Permission checks on `GET /entities/by-former-name/:kind/:namespace/:name` evaluate `catalogEntityReadPermission` against the resolved target entity and return `404 Not Found` (referencing only the queried former ref) when access is denied, preventing any leak of the new entity name. Former-name claims are restricted to the same kind, never shadow a live entity, verify location provenance (`location_key`, `backstage.io/origin-location`, `backstage.io/managed-by-location`) against retained `refresh_state` records, and deterministically reject contested claims. Frontend redirects in Catalog and TechDocs construct internal router paths and sanitize sub-paths. No blocking security findings were identified.

## Findings
| Severity | Category | Location | Issue | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| None | — | — | No security vulnerabilities found in the touched files. | — |

## Passing checks
- **Authn & authz — Route protection & permission enforcement**: `plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/createRouter.ts` (`GET /entities/by-former-name/:kind/:namespace/:name`) authenticates callers via `httpAuth.credentials(req)`, and `AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef` (`plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.ts`) enforces `catalogEntityReadPermission` (returning `{ entity: undefined }` on `DENY` or when the target fails the conditional permission filter in `DefaultEntitiesCatalog.ts`, which produces a 404 without leaking the new entity name).

The brownfield security review for `20261103-210033-feature-new-entity-rename-redirects` has been written to [security_review.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/.sdlc/runs/20261103-210033-feature-new-entity-rename-redirects/security_review.md).

### Key Takeaways
- **Permission enforcement & non-disclosure**: [`createRouter`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/createRouter.ts#L456-L491), [`AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.ts#L134-L159), and [`DefaultEntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/DefaultEntitiesCatalog.ts#L861-L977) enforce `catalogEntityReadPermission` against the resolved target entity and return `404 Not Found` without leaking the new entity name when unauthorized.
- **Anti-hijacking & claim legitimacy**: [`FieldFormatEntityPolicy`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/packages/catalog-model/src/entity/policies/FieldFormatEntityPolicy.ts#L147-L177), [`buildEntitySearch`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog-backend/src/database/operations/stitcher/buildEntitySearch.ts#L221-L250), and [`DefaultEntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/DefaultEntitiesCatalog.ts#L861-L977) enforce same-kind references, prioritize live entities, verify location provenance (`location_key`, `backstage.io/origin-location`, `backstage.io/managed-by-location`) against retained `refresh_state` rows, and reject contested claims.
- **Frontend redirect safety**: [`useEntityFromUrl`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts#L48-L95) and [`useExternalRedirect`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/techdocs/src/reader/components/TechDocsReaderPage/useExternalRedirect.ts#L73-L186) construct internal router paths and strip leading slashes from sub-paths, preventing open redirects.
